situations.title: 혈액 제제 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the blood product type before we hang it.
situations.brief: 걸기 전에 혈액 제제의 종류를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: This is packed red cells, correct?
Let's check the unit against the order.
I'll confirm the product type out loud.

situations.title: 수혈 전 이중 확인
situations.tagline: Let's do the two-person check on this unit before it goes in.
situations.brief: 수혈 전 두 사람이 혈액을 이중 대조하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's verify the unit number and blood type together.
Patient name and ID match the unit?
We both sign off before transfusing.

situations.title: 혈액 가온 적용
situations.tagline: Let's run this through the blood warmer before it goes to the patient.
keyPhrases: Let's route this through the warmer.
Cold blood can drop the patient's temperature.
The warmer is set and ready.

situations.title: 수혈 속도 조정
situations.tagline: Let's set the transfusion rate to match how the patient's holding up.
situations.brief: 환자 상태에 맞춰 수혈 주입 속도를 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's adjust the rate to the patient's pressure.
We can slow it if the numbers stabilize.
I'll watch the response as it runs.

situations.title: 혈액 도착 인계
situations.tagline: The units just arrived from the blood bank—let's check them in together.
keyPhrases: Four units of PRBCs just arrived.
Let's confirm each against the order.
I'll sign for them and log the time.

situations.title: 수혈 중 활력 기록
situations.tagline: Let's chart the vitals now, before and during this transfusion.
keyPhrases: Let's record baseline vitals before we start.
I'll chart vitals every fifteen minutes.
Watch for any change during infusion.

situations.title: MTP 비율 준비
situations.tagline: Let's set up the massive transfusion pack in a 1:1:1 ratio.
keyPhrases: Let's keep red cells, plasma, and platelets in a 1:1:1 ratio.
The next MTP cooler is on the way.
I'll track what's been given so far.

situations.title: 저칼슘 칼슘 보충
situations.tagline: With this much blood, calcium is dropping—let's replace it.
keyPhrases: The ionized calcium is low.
Citrate from the blood is binding calcium.
Let's give calcium and recheck.

situations.title: 수혈 저체온 예방
situations.tagline: The patient's cooling down—let's warm the fluids and the room.
keyPhrases: The temperature is dropping to 35.
Let's warm all fluids and use a forced-air blanket.
I'll raise the room temperature.

situations.title: 혈소판·FFP 순서
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the order—plasma and platelets go with the red cells, not after.
keyPhrases: Let's give plasma alongside the red cells.
Platelets are up next in the ratio.
I'll keep the sequence balanced.

situations.title: 혈액은행 재고 조율
situations.tagline: How many units do you have left—we're going through them fast.
keyPhrases: How many units of O-neg do you have left?
We may need more plasma soon.
Please keep the next cooler ready.

situations.title: 수혈 반응 초기 감시
situations.tagline: Let's watch closely for any early sign of a transfusion reaction.
keyPhrases: Watch for fever, hypotension, or oozing.
Any change in the urine color?
Tell me right away if vitals shift.

situations.title: 희석성 응고장애
situations.tagline: The patient's oozing everywhere—this looks like dilutional coagulopathy.
keyPhrases: There's diffuse oozing from the field.
We may be diluting the clotting factors.
Let's give more plasma and check coags.

situations.title: 산-염기 대사 감시
situations.tagline: Let's draw a gas—I want to see where the pH and lactate are heading.
situations.brief: 대량수혈 중 산-염기 대사 상태를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get an arterial blood gas.
The lactate is climbing.
We need to correct the acidosis.

situations.title: 반복 응고검사
situations.tagline: Let's redraw the coags so we're dosing product off current numbers.
keyPhrases: Let's redraw coags and fibrinogen now.
We'll dose product off the latest results.
I'll send it stat and track the trend.

situations.title: 급성 용혈반응
situations.tagline: Stop the unit—the patient's spiking a fever with dark urine, this could be hemolysis.
keyPhrases: Stop the transfusion immediately.
Fever, hypotension, and dark urine—suspect hemolysis.
Keep the IV open with saline and call the blood bank.

situations.title: 고칼륨혈증 부정맥
situations.tagline: The potassium is critically high and the rhythm's changing—we need to treat this now.
keyPhrases: The potassium is 7.2 with peaked T-waves.
Let's give calcium, insulin, and glucose.
Watch the rhythm—it could deteriorate fast.

situations.title: 시트르산 저칼슘 위기
situations.tagline: Calcium's crashing from all the citrate—the heart's feeling it, push calcium now.
situations.brief: 시트르산 축적에 의한 저칼슘 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The ionized calcium is dangerously low.
Citrate load is depressing cardiac function.
Push calcium and recheck immediately.

situations.title: TRALI 급성 호흡곤란
situations.tagline: The oxygen just dropped and the lungs are wet—this looks like TRALI, stop the unit.
keyPhrases: Sats are falling with new pulmonary edema.
Stop the transfusion—this could be TRALI.
Let's support ventilation and report it.

situations.title: 혈액 재고 소진 위기
situations.tagline: We're almost out of compatible blood—we need an emergency plan right now.
situations.brief: 혈액 재고 소진 위기를 혈액은행과 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're down to our last two units.
Can you release emergency O-negative?
Should we activate a regional blood request?

situations.title: 순환 과부하 TACO
situations.tagline: The patient's overloaded—rising pressure and wet lungs, this could be TACO, slow it down.
keyPhrases: The venous pressure and edema are rising.
Slow the transfusion—this looks like TACO.
Let's give a diuretic and reassess.
